base: Use case: stylized-concept. Rough exploratory game sprite source sheet for Oni Spacewar. Bold FLAT 2D battle style, heavy dark violet outlines, lavender/violet/pink void palette, one flat shadow tone. Cute chubby alien CAT monsters with puffy cheeks and small ears, no humans. Exactly the listed items in ONE left-to-right row, wide clear empty gaps, generous margins, no touching or overlapping, all fully contained. Pure uniform solid light mint #B8E6CA background, no gradient, texture, vignette or ground shadow. No text labels captions titles. Landscape canvas.

subjects.fissure-guardian: Use case: stylized-concept. Rough exploratory game sprite source sheet for Oni Spacewar. Bold FLAT 2D battle style, heavy dark violet outlines, lavender/violet/pink void palette, one flat shadow tone. Cute chubby alien CAT monsters with puffy cheeks and small ears, no humans. Exactly the listed items in ONE left-to-right row, wide clear empty gaps, generous margins, no touching or overlapping, all fully contained. Pure uniform solid light mint #B8E6CA background, no gradient, texture, vignette or ground shadow. No text labels captions titles. Landscape canvas. FIVE separate items: Fissure Guardian phase ONE idle, huge chubby armored void CAT with puffy cheeks, enormous crystalline shoulders and a circular fissure core; same Guardian phase TWO, cracked armor and exposed hot magenta core, wider aggressive stance; separate bright circular shot-ring prefire flash with a clearly visible gap; separate long horizontal directional ground charge warning line; separate large shattered-core death burst. Boss must feel much larger and heavier than ordinary enemies.
subjects.elite-affixes: Use case: stylized-concept. Rough exploratory game sprite source sheet for Oni Spacewar. Bold FLAT 2D battle style, heavy dark violet outlines, lavender/violet/pink void palette, one flat shadow tone. Cute chubby alien CAT monsters with puffy cheeks and small ears, no humans. Exactly the listed items in ONE left-to-right row, wide clear empty gaps, generous margins, no touching or overlapping, all fully contained. Pure uniform solid light mint #B8E6CA background, no gradient, texture, vignette or ground shadow. No text labels captions titles. Landscape canvas. Exactly SEVEN small bold standalone affix icons in this left-to-right order: Swift = double speed chevrons; Volatile = spiked explosion; Warding = shield; Blinking = two offset portal crescents; Splitting = one diamond branching into two; Scorching = flame; Chilling = six pointed snowflake. No characters. Simple distinct shapes readable at 24 pixels; violet outlines, warm pink for hazards and icy lavender for chilling. All icons equally sized, evenly spaced, no text.

cleanup: Edit each exact source sheet: change only mint background to perfectly uniform solid pure white #FFFFFF; remove background grain/noise/gradient/texture/shadows, including gaps and holes. Preserve original item identity, palette, count, ordering, pose, separation and margins. No text.
